description.value: Formerly known as Kitsilano Wine Cellar, this location is now part of the JAK's Beer Wine Spirits chain — a neighbourhood liquor retailer with 10 stores across Greater Vancouver, offering wine, craft beer, and premium spirits. It sits on West 4th Avenue in Kitsilano, a well-travelled cycling corridor, and the brand places emphasis on knowledgeable, personalized staff service rather than a self-serve retail experience. Online ordering with home delivery is available through the chain's website.
